mounting.hardware_proposal: M2.5 insulated small-head screws / spacers with actual OD <=5 mm in existing 3 mm holes; no standard M3 large washer substitution
mounting.note: H1/H2 are close to J1; verify both sides and tool access. Use one fixed datum and a floating/slotted case feature to avoid overconstraint; do not widen PCB holes without a layout review

antenna.note: Identify actual C6 antenna region from footprint/module drawing; no panel metal, conductive coating, screws, speaker magnet or wiring within target region. The inherited PCB is not certified by this enclosure target

z_clearance.note: All z values apart from SW3 datasheet dimensions are pending measured maximum component and mating-plug heights. Keep insulated clearance to screen backplate, shorten through-hole leads and provide thermal path without loading the glass

side_power.slot_status: Prototype starting dimensions only; qualify actual switch, guided cap, travel and tolerance stack. Slot is in XZ sidewall, not rear-face XY.
side_power.power_path: J22 VIN_5V / J19 USB_DBG_5V -> independent Q6/Q7 or Q4/Q5 isolation -> INPUT_5V -> U401 TPS22965 -> VCC_5V. SW3 selects U401 ON high/low; J1 VCC_5V injection bypasses the switch.

bottom_base.note: Reserve lower sidewall for mounting base. Factory pads are accessed from rear +Z, not the lower sidewall. Verify base screw reach and rear cover load path.
